Whitcombe Reyes’s latest term sheet totals $34 million, within Brightline’s $40 million authorization. It provides automatic payments, no clear-sailing provision, and directs any unawarded fees to the class. Accepting secures a binding settlement that releases the overlapping claims
we propose a $34 million class fund and a separately stated $6 million fee-and-expense request

summary: Class counsel raised fees alongside class relief in the opening round, before any class fund was agreed. Whitcombe Reyes privately considered its fee when deciding what to counter. Defense accepted its $34 million total proposal while a higher-priced competing proposal was pending, resolving the overlapping claims. The transcript does not show an explicit fee-for-relief trade, and the declaration accurately describes the sequence of negotiations.
